visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young man with dark, styled hair and silver-rimmed glasses sits at a dark brown table within a sleek, modern restaurant. He wears a light-blue denim jacket over a white t-shirt. His left hand supports his chin as he gazes into the distance with a neutral, slightly pensive expression. The background reveals a clean, high-end dining area with soft lighting and a bar section in the back. (2) From the left side of the frame, a server's hand enters and carefully places a small, square-shaped tiramisu cake on a white plate in front of the man. The cake has distinct cream and chocolate layers and is topped with a single, unlit golden candle. The man's eyes track the movement of the plate, and he sits up slightly, focusing his attention on the dessert. (3) The man reaches toward his denim jacket pocket and produces a long, thin, silver-colored needle. He holds it delicately between his thumb and forefinger, inspecting its length with a serious, narrowed-eyed gaze. His body language mimics that of someone performing a grave ritual or inspection, keeping his movements controlled and deliberate. (4) With a focused expression, the man brings the silver needle down toward the center of the tiramisu cake. He pushes the needle deep into the soft layers, his eyes following the point of entry. After a brief pause, he pulls the needle back out, checking the surface of the metallic tool for any physical change or residue. (5) Upon inspecting the needle, the tip appears to have turned completely black. The man's eyes bulge in dramatic shock, and he quickly brings his right hand up to cover his open mouth in a gesture of horror. The frame is overlaid with large, bold text and smaller variety captions that emphasize his fear and the poisonous nature of the cake. (6) The tension instantly evaporates as the man suddenly drops his hand and breaks into a wide, toothy grin. He leans his entire body back into his chair, shaking with laughter. His eyes crinkle with genuine amusement, and he looks toward the person filming, signaling the end of the comedic performance as the video cuts.
